resources.title: Resource configuration
resources.resourceNote: Positive values set continuous full extraction; unused output becomes surplus.
resources.transferSelf: Choose an available transfer source for the selected regions.

electric.title: Power cost weight
electric.description: Weights the power usage of machines in recipe cost.

guide.title: Tips and guide
guide.locations: All regions are enabled by default. Select specific regions under Factory settings → Locations.
guide.views: Use List for statistics and Flow for the production process. Display rates can be set per minute, hour or day.
guide.power: Add machines to select a power facility. Generated power appears as a negative number.
guide.coupons: Add an item to select coupons directly, or add machines for product exchange (one machine per production line). Ignore the belts shown for final product exchange.
guide.limits: To prevent overproduction, add an item and change its objective from Output to Limit.
guide.objectives: Adding items sets a product output target; adding machines requires a fixed number of running production lines, reusing lines needed by output targets where possible.
guide.archives: Save and load plans in Saved states. Select the game icon in the header to reset.
guide.legacyNotice: The Wuling example uses a legacy version.
